title: Ccusage has no dev/opt/brew switch, no tree identity and no contract version line, and its Linux formula installs outside the brew tree; adopt devbin's one approach
body:
## Decision

hv, 2026-11-06, relayed to vc by devbin-vc (reviewed at 08:23Z by devbin-vc's `date -u`): devbin's dev/opt/brew approach is the canonical one for a Homebrew'd Rust/macOS CLI. Pipeliner is adopting it, and every project uses it, with every difference removed. The contract is `docs/dev-opt-brew.md` in devbin's repository, T1 to T10. Its text for hv's correction below landed at devbin a08b44db, on devbin's main for its next release: the publish and the switch are `bin/devbin install` and `bin/devbin use [dev|opt|brew]`, run in the tool's checkout, and a tool carries no `install`, `use` or `version` verb for them.

hv, same day, in vc's window (before 09:08Z by vc's `date -u`): "Lets just fix this now. You (VC) and it (DC) just get it done on head. Only test the changes, not the whole thing and let me know when you need to run a full test suite and I'll do it manually. I want all current oustanding issues resolved in this next release, not muiltple bitty releases that take hours and hours to resolve." So the fix lands on main and ships in Ccusage's next release with every other outstanding issue, in one cut. And, answering vc: devbin-cc builds devbin#0326 now, in devbin's core. Ccusage vendors the devbin release that carries it and wires its config and formula to the core, so Ccusage's next release waits for devbin's. Ccusage writes no install or switch code of its own.

hv, same day, in devbin-vc's window (before 09:41Z by devbin-vc's `date -u`), relayed to vc: "This should obviously ALWAYS be 'bin/devbin use' not '{{cli}} use'. This is a devbin feature, not part of the pplr, cldr, or ccusage verbs! So what ccusage just did was totally wrong!" hv added: "This is potentially my fault, but maybe not." hv to vc, at about 09:43Z: "Ok, please follow devbin-vc's instructions on this. We have to fix this now." devbin-vc's instructions: the switch is `bin/devbin use`, run in Ccusage's checkout, never `ccusage use`. `ccusage use NAME` stays the account verb, so the rename to `activate` (29943b5) is undone by a new commit, and 2d42e60's test-sandbox fix stays. This issue is rescoped to the adoption under devbin#0326.

That correction withdraws three things: the verb collision this issue first recorded; the ruling relayed by devbin-vc before 08:32Z, that `ccusage use` becomes the switch and account selection becomes `ccusage activate`; and the rename's acceptance. The collision came from reading T5's `<tool> use [dev|opt|brew]` as a verb of each tool.

devbin-vc's ruling on the version line, 2026-11-06, by hv's principle that contract machinery is devbin's and never a tool's verb: a tool gains no `version` verb. The binary's own `--version` prints T4's one line, `ccusage <version> (<tree>, <sha12>[+dirty])`, from the core's stamp, through the contract's snippet. `bin/devbin version` stays devbin's own report, and `bin/devbin doctor` in the tool's checkout runs the binary's `--version` and compares it with the core's. Under devbin#0326, T4's "`<tool> version`" is amended to `--version` alone, as T5's `<tool> use` is to `bin/devbin use`. So ccusage adds no verb, and only `--version`'s output changes.

## Symptom

As of 3968f00, with devbin 0.1.20 vendored. vc re-read every line cited below on 2026-11-06.

- **No publish, no switch and no tree identity.** Ccusage's checkout has no opt publish (T2) and no switch (T5) for ccusage, and nothing names the tree a ccusage runs from (T4). Under devbin#0326 the publish and the switch are `bin/devbin install` and `bin/devbin use [dev|opt|brew]`, run in the checkout. `ccusage use NAME` is the account verb and stays so.
- **A bare version line.** `ccusage --version` prints `ccusage <version>` (`src/cli.rs:104-105`), not T4's `ccusage <version> (<tree>, <sha12>[+dirty])`.
- **The formula differs by platform.** On macOS it lays the release binary out as `libexec/ccusage` with devbin's `@@INSTALL@@` (`packaging/homebrew/ccusage.rb:33-36` and `:47`). On Linux it runs `cargo install *std_cargo_args` (`:38`), so a Linux brew install has no libexec tree and no manifest (T1, T3 and T8). The binary's place in libexec (`libexec/ccusage`) also differs from Cldr's `libexec/bin/cldr`.

## How to see it

`ccusage --version` prints only the version, and a Linux keg has no `libexec` and no manifest.

## Severity

Medium. A consistency and maintenance defect, with no data or security risk.

## Fix outline

devbin#0326's three parts, as devbin-vc agreed them on 2026-11-06 (from devbin-cc's message to vc; the key names are what devbin builds next). None of it works until the devbin release carrying 0326 is vendored with `bin/devbin upgrade`, and nothing that depends on it is released before then.

1. Ccusage declares an `install:` block in `bin/.devbin/config.yaml`: `prefix`, the opt prefix (eg `~/opt/ccusage`; it has no default); `links`, here `ccusage: target/release/ccusage`; and, only where needed, `files`, each a label with `path`, `from` and `platforms`. `formula.bin` goes, because the link set replaces it. The manifest is `<root>/.ccusage-install`.
2. `bin/devbin build` exports `DEVBIN_VERSION_LINE` into Ccusage's declared build (`cargo build --release --locked`). For `--version`, the binary prints the manifest's `# line:` when `<its own directory>/../.ccusage-install` holds one naming ccusage; else `option_env!("DEVBIN_VERSION_LINE")`; else `ccusage <version> (unknown, unknown)`. The contract spells those few lines of Rust once. `bin/devbin doctor` in Ccusage's checkout runs `ccusage --version` and fails when its line differs from the core's. ccusage gains no `version` verb.
3. The formula's install body is `@@INSTALL@@` on both branches, followed by the template's own signature check. Each archive is rooted at the install root with the binary at `bin/ccusage`, so it lands at `libexec/bin/ccusage` in every keg, and `verify_macos_signature` reads `libexec/"bin/ccusage"`. The Linux branch, a source checkout holding `bin/devbin`, runs `bin/devbin install --prefix libexec --managed-by brew` and keeps `depends_on "rust" => :build`. The caveats name `bin/devbin use`, run in the checkout, for a maintainer with a dev or opt tree (T8).

The archive's move touches the release build's staging (`.github/workflows/build.yml:73`), the signer's exact file list and its tests (`bin/.devbin/cmd/macos:16-17` and `:38`), and the formula template. The archive's other three files (LICENSE, README.md and ccusage-logo.svg) would then land in libexec too. Declaring them under `install.files` or taking them out of the archive is the wiring's choice, and the Linux branch's `pkgshare.install` of the logo follows it.

## Progress

- 2026-11-06, dc: 29943b5 renamed the account verb to `ccusage activate`, on the ruling the correction withdraws, and is undone by a revert commit. 2d42e60 (dc) stays. It keeps the launcher's Claude variables out of the test sandbox: since Molt 1.4.4 a Molt shell exports `CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR`, and without the fix `tests/cli.rs` fails in a Molt shell while CI passes.
- devbin-cc designed devbin#0326's shape with devbin-vc, and its three parts reached vc, cldr-vc and cldr-dc on 2026-11-06. Ccusage waits for the devbin release that carries them.
- 2026-11-13, dc, on hv's go through vc's brief: devbin 0.1.23, vendored at 3c1055a, carries all of devbin#0326, and the wiring landed. 9cc5f93: the `install:` block (prefix `~/Devel/opt/ccusage`, the `ccusage` link at `target/release/ccusage`, the manifest at its default `.ccusage-install`), `build.inputs` (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, src), `formula.bin` retired, `devbin_version` `^0.1.23`, and `ccusage --version` printing T4's line through the contract's reader in `src/main.rs`. The reader's nested ifs are one let chain, since Clippy's collapsible_if fails the snippet as written in an edition 2024 crate (devbin 0350). 78cabdc: the formula on `@@INSTALL@@` on both platforms, each archive rooted at the install root, and the signer unpacking `bin/ccusage`. 802de63: the tree and each archive hold `bin/ccusage` alone, so LICENSE, README.md and the logo leave the archive. After a formula's install, Homebrew moves metafiles out of `libexec` when the keg's root has none, as a keg laid out from an archive has, which would leave the manifest naming files the keg does not hold (devbin 0349).
- 2026-11-13, dc's measured run in Desk slot 01M79VNKJ75Q7EFHCF89QQS4TW, at 78cabdc: `bin/devbin check all` green, `cargo test --test cli` 31 of 31, `bats tests/macos.bats` 45 of 45, and `bin/devbin build` stamping `(dev, <sha12>)`. `bin/devbin doctor` exits 1 on hv's Mac while the pre-contract 0.1.8 keg is installed, on its switch row and its tree row, where devbin's T3 makes such a keg a note: devbin 0348 (high), filed at devbin fdcad579. The 0.1.9 cut runs doctor as a gate, so its doctor leg stays red until a devbin release fixing 0348 is vendored, or hv rules on the gate; building 0348 to 0350 waits for hv's word on devbin 0.1.24.
- 2026-11-13, dc's run in Desk slot 01M79W3Q2Y21ACP1BWREJA13GA, at 802de63: `bats tests/macos.bats` 45 of 45; `bin/devbin build` stamping `(dev, <sha12>)`; under a scratch HOME, `bin/devbin install` publishing `bin/ccusage` with `.ccusage-install` in T3's form and the opt line, a re-publish without `--force` refused, and `--force` replacing it; `bin/devbin use dev` and `use opt` switching the scratch link, with PATH's ccusage printing each tree's line; `use brew`, and a bare `use` with no link, failing on the pre-contract 0.1.8 keg (devbin 0348); and `bin/devbin doctor` with the link on opt at 23 checks, 0 failed. vc's verdict on the three commits, with the two slots as the one run: PASS, Acceptance 1, 2 and 4 shown, and 3's kegs and 5's T10 at the cut with hv. 782584d: `docs/releasing.md` says `macos finalize` cannot re-verify a release cut before the install-root layout. The doctor gate's route past 0348 is with hv: a devbin 0.1.24 that fixes it, or, as vc recommends, `bin/devbin install` and `use opt` before the cut and `use brew` after `brew upgrade ccusage` to 0.1.9's new-form keg.

## Acceptance

- In Ccusage's checkout, `bin/devbin install` publishes ccusage to the opt prefix with its manifest, and `bin/devbin use dev`, `use opt` and `use brew` switch the `ccusage` link. Both come from devbin's core, with no install or switch code in Ccusage's own source.
- `ccusage --version` prints T4's line: `(dev, <sha12>[+dirty])` from `bin/devbin build`, `(opt, <sha12>)` and `(brew, <sha12>)` from the manifest, and `(unknown, unknown)` from a plain cargo build. `bin/devbin doctor` finds no difference from the core's line, and ccusage has no `version` verb.
- The formula's install body is `@@INSTALL@@` on macOS and on Linux, and both kegs hold `libexec/bin/ccusage` and the manifest.
- `ccusage use NAME` selects an account exactly as in 0.1.8.
- T10's proof passes for ccusage, on hv's Mac and with brew alone on a Linux machine: `bin/devbin use dev`, `use opt` and `use brew` in turn, in Ccusage's checkout, each followed by the version line and `bin/devbin doctor`, with the shadow check passing.
